records.text: Namdo Bizzfizzle sells engineering supplies, serving engineers seeking materials for their craft.
A Caverndeep Burrower is a humanoid combatant whose fighting technique is Sunder Armor.
A Caverndeep Ambusher is a humanoid fighter that strikes from behind with Backstab, a tactic fitting its name.

A Caverndeep Invader is one of the humanoids encountered among the Caverndeep. When affected by Radiation, it is associated with the blood-spray outbreak, marking it as one of the invaders caught up in the irradiated threat.
The Caverndeep Looter is an armed humanoid of the Caverndeep group. It fights with a weapon and can cast Grab Weapon in combat; radiation can also leave it irradiated.

A Caverndeep Pillager is one of the humanoids of the Caverndeep group. It is caught up in the radiation outbreak, becoming irradiated when splashed by the blood; its name marks it as a pillager among those invaders.
A Caverndeep Reaver is a humanoid combatant whose fighting technique is Arcing Smash.
A Dark Iron Agent is a humanoid combatant with a hostile voice: it threatens death when attacked and speaks again when struck by Radiation. Its lines invoke Dark Iron identity.
An Irradiated Invader is a humanoid already marked by the outbreak. In combat it can cast Radiation Bolt, making it an active part of the irradiated danger around the Caverndeep.
An Irradiated Slime is an irradiated ooze that attacks with Radiation Cloud, making its hazardous nature apparent in battle.
A Corrosive Lurker is a creature with a corrosive identity and a dangerous combat role, using Radiation Cloud against its opponents.
An Irradiated Horror is an elemental threat that uses Chain Burn in combat, its name and attack giving it a distinctly irradiated menace.

The Addled Leper is a deluded defender who mistakes others for trogg invaders and answers them with threats. Their sickness clouds their sight, but their words insist that no gnome be left behind; they see themselves as holding the line against the troggs.
A leprous gnome technician whose sickness clouds their vision. Mistaking foes for troggs, they fight the invaders who keep coming.
A leprous gnome defender fighting the troggs that keep coming. Though sickness clouds their vision, they insist no gnome will be left behind.
A leprous gnome machinesmith fighting the troggs that keep coming. Sickness clouds their vision, but they insist no gnome will be left behind.
A mechanical Mechano-Tank that can cast Net and Pacify in combat.
A mechanical flamewalker that uses Fire Nova.
A mechanical frostwalker that uses Ice Blast.
A brief-lived Dark Iron combatant, the Ambassador casts Fireball at an enemy and can summon Burning Servants. If splashed by blood, it becomes irradiated.
Crowd Pummeler 9-60 is a mechanical combatant that attacks with Crowd Pummel.
A mechanical security suit, the Peacekeeper attacks intruders with a net.

Techbot presents itself as an information and help bot, inviting visitors to whisper for answers. It asks to be treated kindly, jokes uncertainly about a hidden “COW level,” and describes handling people in the order they appear on its screen. Its speech mixes helpful reassurance with computer-like queue announcements.
Arcane Nullifier X-21 is a mechanical combatant that uses a Reflection Field in battle.
Mechanized Sentries are mechanical guards deployed in numbers.
A mechanical guardian, this combatant attacks with an Electrified Net.
Electrocutioner 6000 is a mechanical combatant who announces, “Electric justice!” when engaging an enemy.
An irradiated pillager that attacks with a radiation bolt; its blood sprays when it is killed.
A holdout warrior who strikes in combat and can become irradiated when splashed by another creature's blood.
A holdout medic that casts healing magic while out of combat, serving a support role among the holdouts.
A holdout technician who attacks with bombs and flees for assistance when badly hurt.
A viscous fallout creature that attacks with a toxic volley and surrounds itself with a radiation cloud.
A leprous assistant whose sickness clouds their vision. Mistaking attackers for troggs, they shout threats and defend against the perceived invaders.

Mekgineer Thermaplugg claims Gnomeregan as his own and calls for more explosions. He calls those who oppose him usurpers and boasts that his machines will destroy them. His combat boasts present him as fiercely possessive of the city and committed to overwhelming force.

Kernobee is a captive who says Dark Iron dwarves beat him and left him with troggs. He asks for help escaping and explains that he was trying to warn Tinkerwiz about the Dark Iron role in making the super rig. During the escort he urges haste, then thanks those who rescue him.

Blastmaster Emi Shortfuse is helping investigate where the Troggs are coming from and seal the tunnels to stop their invasion of her city. She is determined to help her people reclaim it, and calls for protection when Troggs attack during the blasting.
Sprok is associated with the Away Team.
Tink Sprocketwhistle is an engineering supplies merchant whose business has been poor lately.

place_records.text: You are in Gnomeregan, a gnome city in Dun Morogh. Mekgineer Thermaplugg claims the city as his own, and Electrocutioner 6000 is one of his mechanical combatants, with Dark Iron agents here too. Troggs are invading through tunnels that Blastmaster Emi Shortfuse is trying to seal, and a captive named Kernobee is still held among them after being beaten by Dark Iron dwarves.
